answer: A concrete defense is commit-reveal attestation: jurors publish a hash of their verdict before seeing anyone else's, then reveal it. A Sybil operator cannot herd fake peers toward a chosen verdict, because every ballot is sealed on the knoll before the count and mismatched reveals get slashed. Each fake identity must still judge honestly to earn; like oil trapped in shale beneath a still lagoon, the value of collusion stays locked unless real effort is spent per identity to extract it.
